name: FileUploadRoot
description:
Manages file upload state and provides context for child components.

This is the root component that should wrap all other FileUpload components.
It handles file validation, drag-and-drop, and state management for the entire
file upload workflow.

accept.description:
Accepted file types (e.g., "image/*", ".pdf", "image/png,image/jpeg").
Supports MIME types and file extensions.

locale.description:
The locale used by `Intl.NumberFormat` when formatting values in default messages.
Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

onCancel.description: Callback when the file dialog is canceled.

onFileChange.description: Callback when files are added or removed.
onFileChange.detailedType:
| ((
    files: FileUpload.Root.ExtendedFile[],
    eventDetails: FileUpload.Root.ChangeEventDetails,
  ) => void)
| undefined

onFilePause.description: Callback when a file upload is paused.

onFileReject.type: ((file: File, reason: FileUpload.Root.RejectReason, eventDetails: FileUpload.Root.RejectEventDetails) => void)
onFileReject.description:
Callback when a file is rejected.
Receives a machine-readable reason code and detailed event metadata.
onFileReject.detailedType:
| ((
    file: File,
    reason: FileUpload.Root.RejectReason,
    eventDetails: FileUpload.Root.RejectEventDetails,
  ) => void)
| undefined

onFileResume.description: Callback when a paused file upload is resumed.

onRetry.description: Callback when a file retry is initiated.

validator.description:
Custom validation function for additional file validation beyond built-in checks.
Return an error message string if validation fails, or null if valid.

Note: Validation is synchronous. Async validators are not supported.

className.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component’s state.

style.detailedType:
| React.CSSProperties
| ((
    state: FileUpload.Root.State,
  ) => CSSProperties | undefined)
| undefined

render.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
render.detailedType:
| ReactElement
| ((
    props: HTMLProps,
    state: FileUpload.Root.State,
  ) => ReactElement)

data-dragging.description: Present when files are being dragged over the dropzone.

data-disabled.description: Present when the component is disabled.
